attempt: Reject decorative slope placement whenever the tilted visual AABB overlaps any neighboring solid cell.
reason_failed: Rotation and an edge click enlarge or shift the enclosing AABB, so a decoration that fits on an ordinary block was often refused next to walls. This violated the user-requested equivalence of normal and inclined placement space.
environment: Windows; Hytale 0.7.2 d769dc3d57881261a62858e1394f0e4de9a21eca; Java 25; Adaptive Surface 0.11.0 user test followed by 0.11.1 native fixtures
error_signature: User repeatedly saw the no-space notice; the new native regression places a unit object next to a wall/ceiling with an edge contact and non-cardinal heading.
workaround: For this product policy, test the normal upright, grid-aligned footprint while retaining the tilted contact pose. Do not use this workaround when exact geometric non-overlap is itself a requirement.

source_refs.description: User-reported regressions, native contracts, six isolated boot checks and installation.
